title: Inner-stage condition on the reachable set
statement: Let $K$ be a natural number, let $R$ be a binary relation on the natural numbers, and let $	ext{Init}$ be a predicate on the natural numbers. For natural numbers $L$ and $v$, the recursive condition over $K$ stages, starting at position $0$ with counter $0$, holds—requiring at each selected position $u$ that $u$ is reachable within $L$ steps from an initial number, that $u\ne v$, and that $R(u,v)$ fails; allowing the alternative condition to hold everywhere; and ending when the counter equals the cardinality of the reachable set—if and only if every element $u$ of that reachable set satisfies $u\ne v$ and not $R(u,v)$.
hypotheses_covered: A binary relation R on natural numbers
A predicate Init on natural numbers
